title: Acute agitation, schizophrenia relapse off medication (31M)
provenance: Vignette written 2026-09-30; expected answers quoted from the MaHTAS CPG Management of Schizophrenia 2nd Ed 2021.

intake.complaint: Brought by police, shouting, threatening staff, hearing voices, refusing to stay.
intake.history: Known schizophrenia, stopped medication one month ago.

primary.label: Acute relapse of schizophrenia / psychotic agitation

actions.label: Rapid tranquillisation if needed (IM haloperidol + lorazepam/promethazine)

evidence.source: CPG Management of Schizophrenia (2nd Edition) 2021 v20230111.pdf
evidence.quote: a combination of IM haloperidol plus lorazepam or promethazine
